meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 把项目的 claude-mem 完整时间线按 ISO 周切成每周一个文件，再逐周串行派子代理写一章叙事摘要，产出 docs/timeline-weeks 下的分周文件与摘要，章数等于时间线覆盖的周数。
howto.when: 当你要求做 “weekly digests”、“week-by-week story”、“serial timeline” 等，或想按周连载、逐周续写项目故事时触发；前提是 claude-mem worker 在运行。

howto.what_en: Splits a project's full claude-mem timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one subagent per week in sequence to write a narrative chapter; chapter count equals the ISO weeks covered.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or narrative chapters of a project's history; requires the claude-mem worker running.
